Stationary rare simultaneous events have O(n^-2) probability by matching enumeration and reversibility, so the n-accelerated compensators converge in L1 to generator 2 birth + 2s death. Expected birth budgets and conditional jump bounds prove tightness, and uniqueness of the nonexplosive immigration–death martingale problem proves full path convergence. The included standard-library script exhaustively checks n=2..6 matching states and every transition, with exact rational arithmetic; finite tests do not substitute for the infinite argument.
